# Replace the filter

Read all of the steps before you start.

1. Set the main switch to OFF.
2. Wait five minutes for the pressure to fall.
3. Open the access panel.
4. Remove the two bolts that hold the filter housing.
5. Remove the filter.
6. Put the new filter in the housing.
7. Install the two bolts. Tighten each bolt to 12 Nm.
8. Close the access panel.
9. Set the main switch to ON.

If the warning light stays on, do the procedure again. If the light is still on,
send a message to the service desk.
